主要内容: Donald Yacktman, a conservative value investor, emphasizes a high forward rate of return when evaluating stocks. This metric, calculated as normalized free cash flow divided by price plus growth rate, reflects expected returns. Yacktman's portfolio includes stocks like Coca-Cola (KO) with a 14.29% forward rate of return and Oracle Corp. (ORCL) with 20.84%. Other stocks with high forward rates include Allergan Inc. at 19.99% and FedEx Corp. (FDX) at 19.71%. Amazon (AMZN) has a forward rate of return of 19.6%, with a stock price of $401, market cap of $185 billion, and P/E ratio near a one-year high at 1,411.2. Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. Ltd. (TSM) has a forward rate of return of 19.55%, with a stock price of $17.18, market cap of $89.09 billion, and P/E ratio at 14.4, lower than 77% of peers. Both stocks are in the technology sector.
